errors.message: job not found
errors.description: The import job does not exist in the active clinic.

errors.message: Import job is not in a state that allows this operation
errors.description: The requested action is not valid for the job's current state.

errors.message: Import execution failed
errors.description: The background import pipeline failed; use the reference and job error to investigate.

errors.message: DPMF validation failed
errors.description: The DPMF file is invalid, corrupt, unsupported, or cannot be decrypted.

errors.message: DPMF validation failed unexpectedly
errors.description: An unexpected error occurred while validating the DPMF file.

errors.message: DPMF upload exceeds the configured size limit
errors.description: The uploaded DPMF file is larger than the configured limit.

errors.message: Migration proposal is invalid
errors.description: The proposed mapping action or target is invalid.

errors.message: proposal not found
errors.description: The mapping proposal does not exist in this import job.

errors.message: Binary checksum does not match
errors.description: The uploaded binary does not match its claimed SHA-256 checksum.

errors.message: Staged binary not found
errors.description: No staged file matches this job and checksum.

errors.message: Parent patient is not mapped yet; retry after import completes
errors.description: The parent patient must be mapped before its document can be imported.

errors.message: Documents are not available — the file cannot be filed
errors.description: The Media module is disabled, so imported documents cannot be stored.

errors.message: Solo se aceptan archivos .xlsx y .csv.
errors.description: Only XLSX and CSV migration sheets are accepted.

errors.message: El archivo pesa más de 20 MB.
errors.description: The migration sheet exceeds the 20 MB limit.

errors.message: Migration sheet is invalid
errors.description: The uploaded sheet is empty, malformed, or has no data rows.

errors.message: Esta hoja ya se convirtió; súbela de nuevo para cambiar las columnas.
errors.description: A converted sheet cannot be remapped; upload it again to change columns.

errors.message: Campos desconocidos
errors.description: The mapping contains fields not supported for this sheet type.

errors.message: Un mismo dato está asignado a más de una columna.
errors.description: A destination field cannot be assigned to multiple columns.

errors.message: Falta asignar una columna a alguno de estos datos
errors.description: The mapping is missing one or more required fields.

errors.message: La app Pacientes no está habilitada.
errors.description: Patient-linked sheets cannot be converted while the Patients app is disabled.

errors.message: Una de las columnas no existe en la hoja.
errors.description: A mapped column index does not exist in the uploaded sheet.

errors.message: Esta hoja no tiene filas con problemas.
errors.description: No problem report was generated for this sheet.

errors.message: export not found
errors.description: The export job does not exist in the active clinic.

errors.message: El archivo de esta exportación caducó y se borró del servidor; genera otra.
errors.description: The export file passed its retention period and was deleted.

errors.message: export file not available
errors.description: The export file is not ready or is no longer available.

errors.message: export still running
errors.description: An export file cannot be deleted while the export is running.

errors.message: Import cannot be undone in its current state
errors.description: Only completed or failed imports with creation tracking can be undone.

errors.message: Import cannot be undone because imported records are in use
errors.description: Downstream clinic activity prevents removing imported records.

errors.message: Import undo failed
errors.description: The background undo failed; use the job error and reference to investigate.

errors.message: No hay espacio suficiente en el espacio de la clínica.
errors.description: The clinic storage limit would be exceeded by this operation.
